def fetch_all_playlists(is_public):
    all_pl = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        res = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        all_pl.extend(res)
        page_index += 1
    return all_pl

public_playlists = fetch_all_playlists(is_public=True)
private_playlists = fetch_all_playlists(is_public=False)
all_playlists = public_playlists + private_playlists
print('playlists total', len(all_playlists))
print('playlist ids', [p['playlist_id'] for p in all_playlists])

# Verify show_playlist songs count matches song_ids count from library for each playlist
playlist_song_counts = []
for p in all_playlists:
    pl_id = p['playlist_id']
    lib_count = len(p.get('song_ids', [])) if p.get('song_ids') is not None else None
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl_id, access_token=access_token)
    songs_count = len(pl.get('songs', []))
    playlist_song_counts.append((pl_id, p['title'], lib_count, songs_count))

print('playlist song count verification (playlist_id, title, lib_song_ids_count, show_playlist_songs_count)')
for row in playlist_song_counts:
    print(row)

# Build mapping song_id -> set of artist names for songs found in playlists
song_to_artists = {}
for p in all_playlists:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p['playlist_id'], access_token=access_token)
    for s in pl.get('songs', []):
        song_id = s.get('id')
        artist_names = [a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists', []) if a.get('name')]
        if song_id is None:
            continue
        # Use unique song across playlists; but allow multiple artists per song
        song_to_artists.setdefault(song_id, set()).update(artist_names)

print('unique songs across all playlists:', len(song_to_artists))

# Count unique songs per artist
from collections import defaultdict
artist_counts = defaultdict(int)
for song_id, artists in song_to_artists.items():
    for an in artists:
        artist_counts[an] += 1

# sort by count desc then name asc
sorted_artists = sorted(artist_counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0].lower()))
print('top 15 artists by unique song count:')
for an, c in sorted_artists[:15]:
    print(an, c)

print('number of artists:', len(sorted_artists))
print('top 6:', [sorted_artists[i][0] for i in range(6)])
